note: This file is a MMDetection configuration file (dict-based config), not a callable Python module. It inherits from gfl_r50_fpn_ms-2x_coco.py and overrides the backbone to use ResNet-101. No functions, classes, or CLI-callable APIs are present.
summarize_config: summarize the GFL ResNet-101 FPN configuration for multi-scale 2x COCO object detection training
review_backbone_override: review the ResNet-101 backbone override with pretrained torchvision checkpoint in the GFL config
build_detection_model: build a Generalized Focal Loss detector using ResNet-101 backbone with FPN for COCO object detection
run_training_config: run the GFL ResNet-101 FPN multi-scale 2x COCO training configuration with MMDetection
refactor_backbone_depth: refactor the GFL config to change the ResNet backbone depth from 101 to another variant
